## [ViDA - How New Changes Will Affect You](https://www.vertexinc.com/resources/upcoming-webcasts-events/vida-how-new-changes-will-affect-you-0)


When it comes to e-invoicing systems, there are three main options available to businesses: on-premise solutions, iPaaS solutions, and fully managed solutions. In this webinar, we will explores the benefits and downsides of each approach, examining the time and effort required by internal teams to ensure a successful result.
